budget.max_nodes: number of selected unit IDs including overlapping annotations
budget.max_utf8_bytes: rendered context UTF8 bytes including literal LF separators

invalid_graph: INVALID_GRAPH_UNKNOWN, empty context, no native query required
matched_baseline: same exact observed effective seed IDs with close_dependencies=False
rendering: merge overlapping/touching spans within excerpt; sort excerpt input order then start/end; join merged span text by one LF; never rewrite source bytes
semantic_scope: Author-supplied dependencies only; not automatic legal parsing, NLI/token-window admission, benchmark accuracy or SOTA
